lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most change types, with only sign-in hints, finish new screens, adoption redesigns, path choice hints, and home redesigns having at least 2 tests.
Sign-in hints, finish new screens, and path choice hints were helpful as each kind included at least one winning test.
Adoption redesigns and home redesigns did not work, showing no clear effect or negative results across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Predictions were significantly too low for unexpected wins like path choice hints (-1.0% predicted vs +4.7% actual) and sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.7% actual).

candidates.title: Sign In Existing Account Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear sign-in hint explaining that logging in with an existing account email automatically restores previously saved pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing back in, indicating users accidentally log into secondary or new accounts.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your existing account email to automatically restore saved pets and sync your cloud data.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Pick Friend Carousel Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection step into a smooth carousel layout to make browsing and picking a pet companion visual and straightforward.
candidates.why: Adoption has a heavy drop-off (69.8% completion rate with median time of 89s and mean of 1017s), showing friction during pet choice.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Swipe through available pet styles to find your perfect desktop buddy.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pick friend screen layout while preserving its core function of choosing a pet.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but historical adoption redesigns showed negative lift (-1.0%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Shortcuts Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated summary screen after home intro showing basic desktop controls (drag, right-click menu, double-click chat).
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.

new_pet_interaction_shortcuts.headline: Quick Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_interaction_shortcuts.body: Right-click your pet for actions and settings, click-and-drag to move across screens, or double-click to talk.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new shortcuts screen after home_intro within onboarding while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Both support emails and funnel metrics support this, and new screens have shown positive lift.

candidates.title: Choose Path Split Comparison Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the path choice screen using a side-by-side split layout contrasting quick ready-made pets with custom AI pet generation.
candidates.why: Path selection mean time is 514s (vs median 8s), suggesting some users get stuck deciding between paths.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Choose a classic pre-made pet for instant desktop fun, or generate a unique companion from your photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns the path choice screen to a split layout while maintaining options to adopt pre-made or create custom pets.

candidates.score_note: Long mean choice time noted in funnel, but redesign changes historically underperform.

candidates.title: Desktop Readiness System Check Info
candidates.change: Adds troubleshooting wait info to the waiting screen explaining background rendering and desktop permission checks.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 emails regarding pets not displaying on desktop or app failing to open properly during launch.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Desktop Companion
waiting.hint: Make sure desktop overlay permissions are enabled if your pet window does not automatically pop up.

guard.reason: Adds standard troubleshooting waiting-screen info and time estimate within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Support emails confirm desktop launch confusion, and wait info changes tend to be positive.

candidates.title: Sign In Delay Post Desktop Waiting Reorder
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after the rendering waiting stage right before home intro.
candidates.why: Lessons show sign-in reordering was a strong unexpected win (+6.7% actual), and placing sign-in after pet render build-up increases commitment.

guard.reason: Reorders sign in to occur after waiting while retaining all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in was a strong unexpected win (+6.7% actual) in past tests.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Framing Clarity Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit photo upload framing instructions on the upload photo screen to ensure optimal AI pet rendering.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails where custom pet generation failed or pet output looked distorted due to bad input photos.

upload_photos.hint: Upload well-lit, centered photos showing your pet's face clearly for the best AI rendering results.

guard.reason: Adds framing clarity hints on the photo upload screen without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Targeting largest drop-off step with support mail backing; hints consistently perform well.

candidates.title: Story Welcome Setup Duration Copy
candidates.change: Updates the story welcome headline and copy to explicitly set expectations that onboarding takes under two minutes.
candidates.why: High mean completion times across all initial steps indicate user hesitation early in the funnel.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.body: In less than 2 minutes, your personalized animated companion will come to life right on your screen.

guard.reason: Updates story copy to set onboarding expectations while still introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Address long mean duration, but path choice copy changes yielded -0.3% previously.

candidates.title: Home Intro Split Command Guide Layout
candidates.change: Changes the home intro layout to a split view displaying pet welcome visuals alongside interactive command previews.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 73.1% with long mean times (5815s) and user post-onboarding interaction confusion.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is ready on your screen! Use your mouse to interact, drag, or open pet controls anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro layout inside onboarding while preserving its introduce-the-pet function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses finish drop-off and support confusion with moderate confidence from past layout tests.

candidates.title: Waiting Completion Desktop Audio & Visual Notification
candidates.change: Enables a desktop notification flag and completion sound hint on the waiting screen when rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, indicating users switch windows while waiting and forget to return.

waiting.hint: You will receive a desktop alert when your pet is fully rendered and ready to play.

guard.reason: Adds waiting completion notifications as allowed under onboarding waiting-screen modifications.

candidates.score_note: Home wait time is high, but home notification test resulted in a -2.4% drop previously.

Home Intro Split Command Guide Layout

Home Intro Split Command Guide Layout

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for most change types, as only eight categories have at least 2 tests.
Sign-in hints, sign-in reordering, finish new screens, and path choice hints were helpful, each yielding at least one winning test.
Adoption redesigns and home redesigns did not work, resulting in negative effects or no clear effect across multiple tests.
Path choice copy and home wait info changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, especially for redesigns.
Predictions were significantly too low for unexpected wins like sign-in reordering and path choice hints.
